title: Protocol
description: Practices for wire formats, framing, and protocol state machines.

practices.title: Validate lengths first
practices.statement: Check every length field against the remaining buffer before any use.

practices.title: Reject unknown input safely
practices.statement: Unknown versions, opcodes, and flags must fail predictably without corrupting state.

practices.title: Complete protocol state machines
practices.statement: Model the wire protocol as an explicit state machine with no undefined transitions.

practices.title: Parsers are fuzz-ready
practices.statement: Structure parsers so fuzzing can reach them; no parser trusts its input.
